title: Protection warrior: engages each of three loose mobs and claps them

rules.desc: The Protection warrior casts Thunder Clap at least once in the fight
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:161-166 (melee light aoe -> thunder clap at ACTION_HIGH + 7, #949); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: two or more mobs in melee hold the light-aoe row active for the whole pack fight, and the clap outranks the single-target builders. Expected PASS at abb91ff62

rules.desc: At most 40 percent of the mob damage events (hits counted, not amounts) land on the healer or the DPS player; the rest on the tank
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:344-355 (loose adds near -> challenging shout, melee medium aoe -> battle shout taunt); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:126-138 (taunt rows), :161-166 (thunder clap, #949); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: an outcome: the player opens all three mobs, so each lands opening hits before the taunts and the clap spread the threat. Expected UNKNOWN at abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently at abb91ff62
